title: SDD workflow configuration (skills/sdd.config.json)
description: One file per repository. Every repo-specific value the SDD skills and scripts need: commands, document and ledger paths, branch and publish conventions, harnesses, harvest and sweep settings, per-skill size budgets. Read by scripts/sdd/lib/config.mjs and by every skill at the start of a run.

$schema.description: Relative or absolute reference to this schema.

$comment.description: Free-form note for readers of the file; ignored by the scripts.

sddVersion.description: The seed version this config was written by (semver). `sdd upgrade` compares a target's scripts against this version's seed to tell an unchanged file from a locally edited one.

repo.description: Everything that is specific to this repository.

name.description: Short repository name used in slugs and file names (e.g. the `<name>-prd.md` doc names). The deploy substitutes it for the template's {{REPO_NAME}} placeholder; a raw template is not a valid config.

defaultBranch.description: The trunk branch. impl refuses to run on it unless the plan declares a hotbug; post-impl publishes onto it.

publish.description: How post-impl publishes a finished branch. `trunk-ff`: fast-forward the branch onto the default branch and push. `pr`: push the branch and open or refresh a pull request, with an optional CI watch and squash-merge (the yolo envelope is available only in this mode).

branches.description: Branch name patterns; `{slug}` is substituted with the plan slug.

feature.description: Pattern for a feature branch, e.g. `feature/{slug}`.

bug.description: Pattern for a bug-fix branch, e.g. `bug/{slug}`.

commits.description: Conventional-commit type prefixes the skills use, and whether an attribution trailer is appended.

feature.description: Prefix for an implementation commit on a feature plan (e.g. `feat`).

bug.description: Prefix for an implementation commit on a bug plan (e.g. `fix`).

plan.description: Prefix for a plan or investigation commit (e.g. `docs(plan)`).

attribution.description: Whether commits carry an agent attribution trailer. false keeps commit messages free of it.

commands.description: Shell commands the skills run. A skill names the key; the agent reads the value here at the start of the run. `TODO` markers left by a `--yes` deploy are flagged by the doc meta-tests.

build.description: Builds the product. Null when the repo has no build step; suite-run then skips the build.

test.description: Runs the full test suite. Required; suite-run.mjs parses its output with the `testRunner` adapter.

testFilter.description: Runs a filtered subset; `{filter}` is substituted. null when the runner has no filter form.

docTests.description: Runs the doc meta-tests and script tests under scripts/sdd/tests/. Required after deploy.

lint.description: Optional lint command; null skips the lint step with an explicit row.

deployTool.description: Optional: how the built product reaches the machine (the "deploy the tool" phase). null skips that phase with an explicit row.

e2e.description: Optional end-to-end suite command; null when there is none.

testRunner.description: Which suite-run.mjs adapter parses the test command's output. `generic` uses the exit code plus an optional `--expect-total`.

sourceGlobs.description: Globs matching product source files; used to classify a diff as source vs test vs docs.

docs.description: Paths of the SDD documents and folders. Skills refer to a document by its key here, never by path.

prd.description: The product requirements document (FR-N / NFR-N with a Grounding Index).

architecture.description: The architecture document, including the Design Decisions record.

stories.description: The stories document: an `## Index` over `## Area:` sections; story ids `S-YYMMDD.HHMMSSx`.

projectStructure.description: The project-structure companion: the reverse architecture/area lookup and the full structure listing.

profile.description: The per-repo SDD profile the skills read at the start of every run: stack conventions a config value cannot carry.

agentGuide.description: Optional agent-instruction document post-impl keeps in sync; null means not configured.

changeChecklist.description: Optional surfaces checklist post-impl's stale-doc audit derives from; null means not configured.

vocabulary.description: Optional product vocabulary document; null means not configured.

plans.description: The plans folder — the impl skill's work queue.

artifacts.description: The archived-plans folder with its tagged index.

ledgers.description: Paths of the four operational ledgers.

friction.description: The F-N friction ledger; owns the SMALL-FIX-RULE, READ-PROTOCOL, EXPIRY-GATE and SCAN-WATERMARK blocks.

testHealth.description: The T-N test-health ledger; owns the ANTIPATTERN-GATE block.

runLog.description: The SDD run log — one row per completed trio run.

testRoi.description: The test ROI ledger written by test-improve's ROI sweeps.

agentSurfaces.description: Files post-impl keeps as stubs or in sync (e.g. CLAUDE.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md). May include product files such as an agent-guide command source.

ui.description: Optional UI surface. null collapses the UI/smoke phases to "no UI surface".

devServer.description: Command that starts the UI dev server.

smoke.description: Command or procedure that performs the UI smoke check.

skills.description: Where the skills live and where they are mirrored.

source.description: The tracked skills folder (source of truth), relative to the repo root.

project.description: The skill directory names `skills.mjs install` copies to each harness's project mirror.

retired.description: Skill names that used to be deployed and are swept from the mirrors by install; status reports a lingering copy as orphaned.

expiryDays.description: Age after which a scanned, still-open F-N may be auto-Declined under the EXPIRY-GATE (clock runs from max(Found, last scan)).

topN.description: How many clusters a harvest selects for action.

patternWeeks.description: How many weeks of run-log and ledger history the pattern scan covers.

digestWhatChars.description: Maximum characters of an entry's What happened included in the digest.

slugPrefixes.description: Plan-slug prefixes that identify harvester-originated plans.

seamPaths.description: Paths whose changes count as touching the SDD seam (skills, ledgers, scripts) in the pattern scan.

sweep.description: Settings for the project-structure sweep that compares the listing document with the files on disk.

listing.description: The document holding the Full Structure Listing (normally the project-structure doc).

scope.description: Globs for the directories the sweep covers.

extensions.description: File extensions (without the dot) the sweep counts.

sizeBudgetBytes.description: One byte budget per skill, measured with CR stripped. 0 means "set at first deploy to the deployed size"; afterwards budgets only ratchet down (the SIZE-RULE).
